title: Joel's Quiet — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 98bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning family Perth youngest
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel was the quietest of the three from the start
He listened before he talked and he watched before his art
Came out of him at the angle nobody predicted
He chose his own direction and by that direction, lived it

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Joel era el más tranquilo de los tres desde el inicio
[Joel was the quietest of the three from the start]
Escuchaba antes de hablar — eso era su servicio
[He listened before talking — that was his service]
Su arte salió de él desde un ángulo no esperado
[His art came from him from an unexpected angle]
Eligió su camino y por ese camino ha caminado
[He chose his path and by that path he has walked]

[Chorus — English]
Joel's quiet, Joel's quiet
Not the silence of having nothing — the silence of the complete
Joel's quiet, Joel's quiet
He doesn't need the room to validate the seat
Joel's quiet is the kind of quiet that a room adjusts to
Not the absence of a voice — the presence of someone who's true
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Joel était le plus calme des trois dès le début
[Joel was the quietest of the three from the start]
Il écoutait avant de parler — c'était son attribut
[He listened before speaking — that was his attribute]
Son art est sorti de lui sous un angle inattendu
[His art came from him at an unexpected angle]
Il a choisi sa route et sur cette route il a vécu
[He chose his road and on that road he has lived]

[Outro — All three languages]
Joel's quiet… El silencio de Joel… Le silence de Joel
Presence, not absence — Presencia, no ausencia — Présence, pas absence
That's my boy
